criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Application & Delivery
categories.definition: Queries about applying for a new card, checking delivery status, understanding physical vs virtual card options, eligibility, or fees related to card issuance.

categories.name: Card Activation & PIN Management
categories.definition: Questions about activating a new card, finding, changing, unblocking, or troubleshooting issues with a card PIN or passcode.

categories.name: Card Usage & Troubleshooting
categories.definition: Issues with card functionality (e.g., not working, declined, contactless), ATM usage, where a card is accepted, or specific questions about virtual card features and limits.

categories.name: Lost, Stolen, or Damaged Card
categories.definition: Reporting a lost, stolen, or damaged card, requesting a replacement, or freezing a card.

categories.name: Account Opening & Eligibility
categories.definition: Questions about opening a new account, age requirements, or eligibility criteria for banking services.

categories.name: Account Access & Security
categories.definition: Issues with logging into the app, forgotten account passwords, or accessing the account after device loss.

categories.name: Account Information & Updates
categories.definition: Requests to change personal details, update address, or general inquiries about account information.

categories.name: Account Closure
categories.definition: Requests to close or delete an existing account.

categories.name: Top-up Methods & Issues
categories.definition: Questions about how to add money to an account (top-up), supported methods (e.g., cash, card, digital wallets), troubleshooting failed top-ups, or allowing others to add funds.

categories.name: Top-up Limits & Auto Top-up
categories.definition: Inquiries about maximum top-up amounts, restrictions, or issues with automatic top-up functionality.

categories.name: Top-up Verification
categories.definition: Questions about why top-ups require verification or issues encountered during the top-up verification process.

categories.name: Transfer Initiation & Methods
categories.definition: Questions about how to send or receive money via transfers, supported transfer types (e.g., SWIFT), general transfer instructions, or transfer policies and rules.

categories.name: Transfer Status & Delays
categories.definition: Inquiries about transfer processing times, pending transfers, or delays in funds reaching the recipient or account.

categories.name: Transfer Failure & Troubleshooting
categories.definition: Issues with transfers not going through, being declined, or account restrictions preventing transfers.

categories.name: Salary & Direct Deposits
categories.definition: Questions about receiving salary payments or making other direct deposits into the account.

categories.name: Unauthorized & Disputed Transactions
categories.definition: Queries about unrecognized transactions, fraudulent activity, double charges, or needing to reverse a transaction.

categories.name: Fees & Charges Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions about specific fees (e.g., transfer, withdrawal, card payment, exchange), general fee policy, or unexpected charges.

categories.name: Refund & Reimbursement Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions about the status of a refund, requesting a refund, or issues with receiving the correct reimbursement amount.

categories.name: Exchange Rate & Currency Conversion
categories.definition: Questions about exchange rates, conversion fees, or issues with incorrect amounts received during currency exchange.

categories.name: Transaction Status & Troubleshooting
categories.definition: Queries about pending transactions, failed transactions, or issues with money not being received or showing up correctly in statements.

categories.name: Identity & Fund Verification
categories.definition: Questions about identity verification requirements, the process, necessary documents, or verifying the source of funds.

categories.name: Supported Currencies & Services
categories.definition: Questions about supported currencies, accepted card schemes, or the geographical availability of banking services.
